name: Diner — Select dish options and manage cart
description: A diner selects customizable options for a dish, adds it to cart, adjusts quantities, and verifies running cart totals.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the venue scan page at /scan?outlet_id=demo-outlet&table=4
Click on a customizable dish item to open its options accordion
Select required option group choices (e.g. Spice Level or Side Dish)
Verify the floating cart button updates to show 1 item with the correct subtotal in Naira
